name: Provider Sign-In Faults
summary: The user selects Microsoft as the representative supported-provider permutation and the provider callback, assertion validation, or mobile token exchange fails, returning to a deterministic recoverable fault surface without resolving a durable identity.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the provider round trip is configured to fail before a valid durable identity is resolved

serverInteraction.intent: Normalize provider, callback-validation, or mobile token-exchange failure without creating, linking, or authenticating a durable identity.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and no durable identity was created, linked, or authenticated

sourceReferences.note: External Identity Provider category reconciliation separates linked-subject sign-in, provider denial/fault, first-time registration, and provider link/unlink management while preserving provider-specific choices as permutations.
